property_summary: Any caller other than the fixed owner address causes transfer to revert, for every valid input, so it can never return true.
Calling transfer with an empty recipient array always reverts (even before any other check can pass), for any value array.
For any single-recipient call with a small value, transfer always reverts when invoked by a non-owner, so it can never return successfully.
Since msg.sender can never equal the fixed owner address, transfer always reverts for any recipient/value arrays, leaving c's balance unchanged.
A call to transfer never changes the contract's public state variables from() and caddress(), whether it succeeds or reverts.

For any input, C.transfer always reverts when called by an address other than 0x9797055B68C5DadDE6b3c7d5D80C9CFE2eecE6c9 (the hardcoded owner), so no caller that is not the owner can ever make it succeed.
C.transfer always reverts for a caller that is not the hardcoded owner, even with a minimal valid input (one recipient, value 0).
C.transfer always reverts when given an empty recipient list, for any caller.

property_summary: For any recipient list and values, C.transfer always reverts when called by any address other than the hardcoded owner, so it can never succeed nor change state.
For any recipient list and values, C.transfer always reverts when invoked by any address that is not the hardcoded owner, so it can never return true.
